tasks.title: Angle target angle from the rates
tasks.statement: Betaflight 2025.12 (the formula is the same as in 4.5), Actual rates: `roll_rc_rate` = **{rc}**, `roll_srate` = **{sr}**, `roll_expo` = 0; `angle_limit` = **{lim}**. The roll stick is deflected to **{x}** of travel. Find the roll target angle in Angle (°).
tasks.solution: `pidLevel()`: target = `angle_limit` · setpoint / max_rate. Actual with expo 0: setpoint = x·rc·10 + (srate·10 − rc·10)·x², maximum = srate·10 °/s. With the defaults 7/67 and x = 0.5: 185/670 · 60 = 16.6°.

tasks.title: Horizon leveling strength
tasks.statement: Horizon (2025.12, the formula is the same as in 4.5) with the defaults (`horizon_level_strength` 75, `horizon_limit_sticks` 75, `horizon_limit_degrees` 135). The aircraft inclination is **{a}°**, the stick is deflected to **{s}** of travel. Find the leveling strength (0…1) in steady state.
tasks.solution: `calcHorizonLevelStrength()`: s = 0.75 · (1 − inclination/135) · (1 − stick/0.75), each factor no less than 0. Setpoint = acro·(1 − s) + angle·s. The rise of s is additionally smoothed by the PT1 `horizon_delay_ms` (500 ms), the fall is instant.

tasks.title: The P term of dynamic idle
tasks.statement: `dyn_idle_min_rpm` = **{n}**, `dyn_idle_p_gain` = **{p}**. The slowest motor is spinning at **{r}** RPM. Find the contribution of the P term alone to the increase of the lower motor limit (% of the range), before the limits.
tasks.solution: `mixerInitProfile()`: target = n·100/60 rev/s, the P gain = p·0.00015 per 1 rev/s. The error is (n·100 − r)/60 rev/s. With 30/50 and 2000 RPM: 16.67 · 0.0075 = 12.5 %. The sum P + I + D is then limited by `dyn_idle_max_increase` (15 %) or, until the throttle is first raised, by the value of `motor_idle` (5.5 %; in 4.5 — `dyn_idle_start_increase`, 5 %).

tasks.title: DShot output in turtle mode
tasks.statement: Betaflight 4.5 (in 2025.12 `crashflip_expo` was removed and the turtle power is calculated differently — the task is kept for 4.5). Turtle mode, QUADX, `dshot_idle_value` 550 (5.5 %), dynamic idle off, `crashflip_expo` = **{e}**, `crashflip_motor_percent` = 0. The roll stick is deflected to **{x}** of travel, pitch and yaw are centered. Find the DShot value for the working motors (before rounding).
tasks.solution: `applyFlipOverAfterCrashModeToMotors()`: the lower limit is 48 + 0.055·1999 = 157.9, the upper is 2047. The deflection x' = (1 − e/100)·x + (e/100)·x³, the deadband min' = the same for 0.15. Power = (x' − min')/(1 − min'), output = 157.9 + power·1889 − 20 (`CRASH_FLIP_DEADBAND`). With e = 35 and x = 0.6: power 0.407, output 907.
